announce.title: Veterans Breakfast, fundraiser & classic car show — Nov 14 (BIG SATURDAY)
announce.details: Sat Nov 14, 8–10 AM, 9818 Beachwalk Drive (near High Tide). Veterans fundraiser breakfast sponsored by Xfinity Communities: pancakes, sausage, bagel sandwiches; $15 donation requested to benefit a local veterans group, kids free, cash preferred. Classic car show honoring veterans with DJ John Ross (J&C Entertainment), food and prizes for Top 3 cars. Car pre-registration: mpdross@yahoo.com.
